limits_of_inference: Event times are controller observation times; pending-not-admitted includes pipe and observation delay and is not an exact queue gauge.
One-second cumulative GC counters do not locate pause intervals or distinguish scheduler, native work, and GC in an individual call.
Native public-call durations are elapsed time and do not measure CPU time or prove a causal stack.
scope: bounded post-run diagnostic; no workload, profile, test, rerun, or acceptance credit
